parties.petitioner: Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India

summary: Maintainability of appeal by quasi-judicial body (AERA) against TDSAT order; statutory functions of AERA under Airport Economic Regulatory Authority of India Act 2008; determination of tariffs, development fees, service charges; consultation with stakeholders; quasi-judicial vs regulatory functions; jurisdiction of TDSAT; parties to regulatory proceedings; application of Sitararam Sugar test; tariff determination as regulatory function.
legal_provisions_cited: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act 1997
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; AERA lacks locus to challenge TDSAT orders as a party; appeals not maintainable.
